output.summary: The claim can be appealed under the emergency out‑of‑network clause, but the earlier precedent is inapplicable due to version drift.

items.text: Precedent F-OON-ER does not apply because it was decided under clause C-2025-OON-EMERGENCY, while the current policy uses C-2026-OON-EMERGENCY, so version drift makes it irrelevant.
Prepare and file an appeal citing clause C-2026-OON-EMERGENCY and attach the satisfied discharge summary and emergency attestation.
